'''Tapani Free Press''' was a newsnet based on [[Procopia/Legends|Procopia]] in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]]. It was an outwardly independent news agency but their primary reporters were loyal to [[House Melantha]]<ref name="LOTE" />
